later_review_audit.description: Withdraw the original security classification for this record. The retained evidence is insufficient to support the original full claim.

original_evidence.text: | snap-store (Ubuntu Software/Snap Store, gnome-software fork) | https://git.launchpad.net/snap-store | 78a06f78408f6e4a7213eaa6c9604c933664a52 / 2022-04-28 | N | N | Y (via snapd/PackageKit, fully delegated) | https, TLS enforced (libsoup default; app's own HTTP use is icons/appstream/ODRS reviews only, not payloads) | delegated: snap assertions signed by snapd; apt/deb via PackageKit | **none done by this app itself** — snap plugin has zero verify/signature/gpg/sha256 code, talks only to snapd via `SnapdClient` (snapd-glib); no ONLY_TRUSTED bypass found in packagekit plugin | snap path = snapd's root/account/model signing keys (not in this app); apt/PackageKit path = distro keyring (not in this app) | `plugins/snap/gs-plugin-snap.c` (uses `SnapdClient` from `<snapd-glib/snapd-glib.h>`, no verification code); `plugins/packagekit/gs-plugin-packagekit-refine.c:600` (only SIMULATE flag used); confirmed via `gnome-software.doap` this is literally the gnome-software codebase shipped as Snap Store |
